item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 29
item.description: · AWS highlighted Lambda MicroVMs as disposable sandboxes for AI agents to execute generated code without exposing credentials.（AWS Developers on X） · MiniMax said its open-weight H3 Max model achieved a significant leaderboard milestone, highlighting continued progress in its video-generation ecosystem.（MiniMax on X） · Databricks published practical guidance for moving AI prototypes into production, covering implementation patterns and operational considerations.（Databricks on X） · Sony Music and Warner Music sued Anthropic, alleging unauthorized copying of copyrighted lyrics for AI training and generated responses.（TechCrunch） · Hailuo demonstrated H3 Max generating continuously extendable anime, positioning longer narrative continuity as a practical use for AI video.（Hailuo AI on X） · Tripo previewed Smart Mesh P2.0 through a game-companion creation challenge offering $6,000 in total prizes.（Tripo AI on X） · AI-generated video is increasingly replacing some actors and livestreamers in China’s entertainment workflows, according to an industry report.（The Decoder） · HarmonyOS 7’s visual AI supports natural-language image retrieval and low-resolution image enhancement within real-world applications.（InfoQ 中文） · An investigation found that differences across 734 software dependencies can materially degrade locally deployed AI models versus official implementations.（量子位） · Google’s WikiSkill gives AI agents persistent records of previous successes and failures to improve performance on future tasks.（The Decoder） · A Claude-based research agent reportedly outperformed human researchers costing $150 per hour while operating at roughly $4 per hour.（量子位） · A newly open-sourced OCR tool reportedly converts PDF content into Markdown in 20 milliseconds, nearly 300 times faster than a comparison system.（量子位） · Alibaba’s Qoder coding product targets non-programmers with natural-language software creation and agent-assisted development workflows.（量子位） · Intel’s 32GB Arc Pro B70 GPU is being positioned for local AI-comic production and other memory-intensive generative workloads.（量子位）

item.title: ⚡ 13 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 29
item.description: · China’s first vehicle-mounted mobile token factory debuted as an experiment in coordinating AI computing workloads with electricity supply.（IT之家） · LAION released BVD, an open research dataset spanning 80 million videos and 10 million hours of multimodal footage.（The Decoder） · A Canadian creator’s promotion of Claude drew extensive criticism, illustrating growing social resistance to publicly endorsing AI tools.（IT之家） · US immigration authorities plan to spend $2 million procuring robotic dogs for enforcement operations.（IT之家） · Meshy hosted its first Creator Day, bringing 3D creators together for demonstrations, discussion and product feedback.（Meshy on X） · Tencent compressed Hy4-preview from 1.5 terabytes to roughly 200 GiB using its calibration-guided MIX-STQ1_0 quantization method.（Tencent Hunyuan on X） · Pika added access to Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash through its API Club.（Pika on X） · Pika compared Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 using identical product-video inputs.（Pika on X） · Dreamina launched weekly Discord activities offering product updates, creator networking and a chance to win 25,000 generation credits.（Dreamina on X） · Ollama completed the cloud rollout of GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash with US and European hosting and zero data retention.（Ollama on X） · Ollama published instructions for configuring Claude Desktop to use GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash.（Ollama on X） · OpenAI’s WebMCP Challenge entered its final weekend, with projects due September 3 and an official support session planned.（OpenAI Developers on X） · Luma announced a maker night featuring senior-creator walkthroughs, a shared prompt exercise and in-person creative support.（Luma AI on X）
